text: I think you'll really enjoy this Apple Bread recipe! It features a key ingredient that you seem to like: vanilla. With three large eggs and a generous amount of sugar, this recipe is likely to satisfy your sweet tooth. The addition of chopped nuts and apples adds a nice texture and flavor combination. While it does take a bit longer to prepare than some of your other liked recipes, the end result is likely to be worth the extra time. Give it a try!
